headline: Credit Grows 11.59%, Capital Flow Continues to Be Directed to Production and Business
summary: Outstanding credit across Vietnam's economy reached about 20.75 million billion dong by end-September 2026, up 11.59% from end-2025. Lending continues to focus on production, business and priority sectors.
why: Credit growth is a key gauge of economic activity and banking-sector lending conditions, which investors track when assessing Vietnam's growth outlook.
